newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Gross yield in Czech 4-wk T-bills 16.2 pct 18.5pct.
newsitem.headline: Gross yield in Czech 4-wk T-bills 16.2 pct 18.5pct.

text.p: Gross yield in a Czech National Bank (CNB) auction of a nine billion tranche of four-week Finance Ministry treasury bills was 16.20 percent, the CNB said on Thursday.
Gross yield in the last auction of four-week T-bills in late June was 18.5 percent.
The CNB said all bids totalling 5.145 billion were taken, while the rest was bought by the Finance Ministry along with another six billion tranche which was not offered ion the auction.
